# StreamFamily for a live stream that started 2 hours, 21 minutes and 43
# seconds ago, at 11:23:37 on 15 June 2009 in the time zone of the profile

$streamtitle ($streamgamename)

$streamuptimetotal = $streamuptimehours h $streamuptimeminutes min $streamuptimeseconds s
